description_sq:
Afersia me Liqenin dhe Kopshtin Zoologjik e ben kete prone nje investim shume te mire.
Apartamenti organizohet nga nje dhome ngrenje dhe ndenje bashke, nje dhome gjumi, nje tualet, nje korridor dhe nje ballkon.
Eshte i shtruar me parket dhe ka orientim nga lindja. Banesa ka punime shume cilesore teksa eshte e arreduar ne menyre bashkekohore. Sistemi ngrohes-ftohes eshte chiller dhe multisplit.
Gjithashtu disponon dokumenta te rregullta pronesie.
description_en: The proximity to the Lake and the Zoo makes this property a very good investment. The apartment is organized by a common dining and living room, a bedroom, a toilet, a corridor and a balcony. It is paved with parquet and has an east orientation. The apartment has very high-quality works as it is furnished in a contemporary way. The heating-cooling system is chiller and multisplit. It also has regular ownership documents.
